title: Deeper/broader open-source ACIS and 3D-consumer candidate screen
mode: Primary project-source research and local plan crosswalk
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Search for newly surfaced open-source DWG/DXF/ACIS parsers, CAD consumers, renderers, and independent B-rep routes.
Separate parser lineage, payload decoding, geometry interpretation, rendering, and document conversion evidence.
Update the existing PAR-07/S8 evidence plan only where research yields implementation-ready guidance.

sources.observed: The README describes ProCad.IO as ACadSharp-backed DWG/DXF load/save and advertises ACIS rendering. This is an application/renderer route using an already-counted parser lineage, not a new file reader.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project documentation only; no executable was run, and renderer success cannot prove object-graph or B-rep semantics.

sources.observed: The renderer identifies ACadRust entities and describes an ACIS-to-kernel lift with per-surface fallback. It marks meshes incomplete if all faces do not lift.
sources.evidenceCeiling: This is a downstream rendering description in the ACadRust/OpenCADCodec family, not independent DWG/DXF or ACIS parsing evidence. No renderer was run.

sources.observed: The disclosure says the alternate DWG parser is gated/licensed, extracts 3DSOLID, partially decodes embedded SAB, and does not yet provide full B-rep tessellation; it may return a wireframe or bounding-box fallback.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Not an open-source comparator or complete semantic route; no licensed package was acquired or executed.

sources.revision: Mutable repository README format matrix reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The README advertises broad DWG/DXF product compatibility, but its explicit ACIS SAT/SAB read and write entries are unchecked and no immutable ACIS-capable release/runtime evidence was found in the reviewed page.
sources.evidenceCeiling: README-level screen only; no source build or runtime test. Do not infer ACIS support from broad product labels.

sources.revision: Current project issue ledger, API documentation, and issue #228 reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: BRL-CAD publishes a distinct NURBS B-rep library based on OpenNURBS. The issue ledger still identifies SAT import/export converters as future work. Its DXF conversion route is a geometry projection, while the POLYFACE bounds issue remains open in the reviewed source.
sources.evidenceCeiling: The B-rep library has no reviewed SAT/SAB input route or AcDs owner join; dxf-g does not preserve a complete DXF document. No peer build or execution occurred.

assessment.planImpact: Refines the existing optional PAR-07/S8 composed evidence ledger with parser-lineage and per-body completeness dispositions. The expanded candidate screen adds no qualifying independent end-to-end route and does not alter implementation order, dependencies, validation cadence, or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only primary project-source web review and local plan reconciliation
method.limitations: The candidate repositories and documentation are mutable and were not built or executed. Findings are source-disposition and evidence-readiness guidance only, not runtime qualification. Candidate families already counted in the plan remain correlated rather than independent.
